name: Renamer
description: Renames your videos, images, audio and text documents to a naming pattern you choose, and can file them into folders to match.
author: alextomas955

tutorialTopics.title: Renamer
tutorialTopics.description: Build each file's name from the metadata Cove already holds, preview every change before anything touches disk, then rename - and undo the last run.

slides.title: Renamer documentation
slides.caption: The settings panel is under Settings, Extensions, Renamer. Templates, tokens, destinations and undo are covered in full on the docs site.
